answer_1.quote: we evaluate AI feedback for [...] where many users critically need support because they lack the language proficiency needed to evaluate MT outputs.

answer_2.quote: To control for feedback quality, we balance the error rates of feedback predictions across all types [...] We compute XCOMET-QE scores between the Spanish MT and its backtranslation [...] We use F1, a standard similarity measure in QA research.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a between-subjects human study with 91 English-speaking monolingual participants [...] For each example, participants first make a judgement based solely on an English sentence and its corresponding Spanish translation. They are asked to answer two questions: (1) Shareability: To the best of your knowledge, is the Spanish translation good enough to safely share with your Spanish-speaking neighbor? and (2) Confidence: How confident are you in your assessment? [...] We recruit five bilingual annotators to independently annotate each MT output for gold shareability labels.
answer_4.guideline: Participants judged shareability (binary) and confidence (5-point Likert scale). Gold labels collected by bilingual annotators.
